issues.description: The problem asks for the average (durchschnittliche) area of municipalities per county (Landkreis) along with the county name and its Regierungsbezirk (Aufgabe 05). The provided solution uses COUNT(flaeche) instead of AVG(flaeche), so the reference solution returns a count of rows rather than the requested average. This is a semantic error in the solution repository and will mislead students who compare against the model answer or tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution query to use AVG(flaeche) instead of COUNT(flaeche). For example: SELECT regierungsbezirk, kreis, AVG(flaeche) FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY regierungsbezirk, kreis ORDER BY kreis
